title: fix(spec): describe CompleteUploadRequest.eTag as stored, not compared
body:
Closes #24648

Clause-②: no

## What changes

`CompleteUploadRequestSchema.eTag` (`packages/spec/src/api/storage.zod.ts`) described itself as `S3 ETag verification`. No runtime path verifies it. The description now says what runs:

> ETag the client reports for the uploaded object. Stored on the file record as sent and not compared with anything: no storage adapter reports a stored object's ETag. Before committing, the door checks that the storage backend holds bytes under the file's key and, when the upload declared a size, that the held size equals it.

Route: amend the describe, per the triage lean and the claim. No shape change, no new check, no retirement. The key keeps the same type and optionality.

## Evidence the new sentence is accurate (read on `origin/main` 3a931fca18)

- `packages/services/service-storage/src/storage-routes.ts`, `POST /storage/upload/complete`: the body's `eTag` goes into `store.updateFile(fileId, { status: 'committed', etag: eTag ?? undefined })`. It is stored verbatim and never read before that write.
- In the same file, `heldBytesRefusal` (added with PR #24643) runs before the write. It refuses when `storage.exists(file.key)` is false. When the row declares a size, it also refuses when `storage.getInfo(file.key).size` differs from that size. Its own docblock says the eTag is not compared, because no adapter's `getInfo` reports the stored object's ETag.
- `StorageFileInfo` (`packages/spec/src/contracts/storage-service.ts`) has no `etag` member.

## Files

- `packages/spec/src/api/storage.zod.ts`: the describe.
- `content/docs/references/api/storage.mdx`: regenerated by `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated --fix`, which proved only `check:docs` stale and ran `gen:docs`. Not edited by hand.
- `.changeset/24648-etag-describe.md`: `@objectstack/spec` patch.

No test pins the old sentence. The only occurrences of `S3 ETag verification` were the schema and the generated reference page. The key is not in any `packages/spec/liveness/*.json` ledger. The one hit in `qa.json` is the substring inside `parseTagsFlag`. No other open PR touches `storage.zod.ts` or `references/api/storage.mdx`; I read the file lists of all open PRs before opening this one.

## Verification (head 57b0e5a197, after merging origin/main)

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck`: exit 0, including the `check:test-typecheck` layer.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test`: 702 files passed, 21349 tests passed, 1 todo.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: red before the regeneration (1 of 14 stale: `content/docs/references/**`). Green after `--fix`.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: derived 104 commands. All 104 ran. 103 exit 0 (6 of them were re-run after building their declared prerequisites: `@objectstack/lint` and its closure, `@objectstack/formula`, `@objectstack/client-react`, `@objectstack/objectql`).
- NOT MEASURED: `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads`. Reason: it needs a whole-workspace `pnpm build` (29 or more packages have no `dist/`), and that build does not fit the local budget. The diff changes one describe string and no package entry point. Declared to CI.

## Acceptance notes

- Enforcing the eTag would be a contract addition: an `etag` on `StorageFileInfo`, the S3 adapter reporting `HeadObject`'s `ETag`, and a compare at the commit door. Retiring the key would be a protocol change. Both are left out, per triage.
